title: Travel plans
description: Listen to a short travel plan and choose what you hear.
audioText: I am going to take the train. My ticket is ready. The journey takes about two hours.

items.prompt: How is the speaker going to travel?
items.transcript: I am going to take the train.

items.prompt: Complete: The journey takes about two ____.
